args.stdin: WITH product AS ( SELECT product_sku, record_path FROM product_variants WHERE brand = 'Heco' AND product_name = 'Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ Wood and Drywall Screw' ), props AS ( SELECT p.product_sku, MAX(CASE WHEN property_key = 'screw_type' THEN property_value_text END) AS screw_type, MAX(CASE WHEN property_key = 'diameter_mm' THEN property_value_text END) AS diameter_mm, MAX(CASE WHEN property_key = 'pack_count' THEN property_value_text END) AS pack_count FROM product_variant_properties p JOIN product ON p.product_sku = product.product_sku GROUP BY p.product_sku ) SELECT product.product_sku, product.record_path FROM product JOIN props ON product.product_sku = props.product_sku WHERE props.screw_type = 'wood screw' AND props.diameter_mm = '3' AND props.pack_count = '100 pcs';
